correctness.rationale: For n=4^m, the valuation reflection identity p(n-1-a)=nu_2(a) mod 2 partitions every greedy boundary into pairs (2j-1,2j): one length-two border if nu_2(2j) is odd, otherwise two length-one borders, with unbordered center 10. The exact count T=(n/2-2)/3 yields (2n+1)/3. The injective 2-uniform morphism doubles all shortest borders because the base intermediate factors end in 0, excluding odd borders of their images. A separate structural proof of greedy maximality is supplied. Code verify.py reproduced all k=0..13 and independently optimized k<=8 plus all binary words through length ten. The infinite statement rests on the proof, not diagnostics.

value.rationale: The exact maximal block-palindrome width is a natural invariant introduced in the cited 2018/2023 literature. This gives a structural classification at every substitution scale for a canonical, nonperiodic automatic sequence; it contrasts linearly growing deterministic widths with the bounded asymptotic expected width of random words and identifies two sharp normalized phases 2/3 and 1/3. Both optimal block layouts and their all-level counts follow directly from valuation parity, and the result has no arbitrary cutoff.
